name: approval-gate-enforcement
cost_provenance: measured 2026-09-30 on the dev workstation (win32, under concurrent cargo load), static mode; see docs/planning/project-checks-review-2026-09.md
question: Can a work order reach an execution state without an owner-authored approval? transition_work_order must gate every execution-state transition on has_approved_event before its write; only the repository's transition_in_executor/update_state_in_executor write work_orders.state, only transition_work_order calls the former, and production code never calls the latter.

output.schema: PASS or FAIL <n> with probe-level offender detail (file:line). Exit 0 PASS, 1 FAIL, 2 environment error. A missing target is a FAIL, never a vacuous PASS.

consultation.typical_sessions_using: every-commit touching the work-order state machine, handler, or ledger

consumer_scope: feedbackmonk: every change that touches the paths in freshness.triggers; gated at finalize (verification.projectOracles: gate) and in CI.
fallback: Read .claude/project-oracles/approval-gate-enforcement/README.md: it lists each probe as rewritten on 2026-09-30 and what to check by hand; the `question` above is the one-paragraph form.

provenance.authored_by: P5a Stage 0 (Task Zero scaffold) — finalized by Worker A as the state machine + handler land
provenance.rationale: Testability Gate Flag 1 (the highest plan-wide fidelity risk, Q2=5): the work-order approval gate is THE security boundary between public internet input and code execution (FR-FBR-25a). A happy-path unit test confirms `approve -> approved` but cannot prove the ABSENCE of bypass code paths; an execution-state row with no `approved` event is a remote-code-execution path from public feedback. This oracle is detection-from-STATE (state-machine source + handler + ledger), the anti-reward-hacking leg per Contract C22 invariant 1 — it cannot be satisfied by a self-reported flag. Scaffolded in Stage 0 (Probe A live; B/C co-evolve with Worker A); a green oracle is Worker A's exit gate.
